description: Source code for complex tensor operations in PyTorch, including tensor promotion, complex number handling, and dispatch mode for complex tensors.

classes.name: ComplexTensorMode
classes.description: A TorchDispatchMode that replaces Tensors with complex dtype with ComplexTensor for computation.

methods.name: is_complex_tensor
methods.description: Checks if an object is a ComplexTensor.

methods.name: promote_tensors
methods.description: Promotes tensors to a common dtype, promoting CPU tensors to at least float32.

methods.name: register_complex
methods.description: Decorator to register an implementation for specific ops.

methods.name: register_force_test
methods.description: Registers ops to be forcibly tested even if they error on normal inputs.

methods.name: lookup_complex
methods.description: Looks up an implementation from the dispatch table for a given operation.

methods.name: is_complex
methods.description: Detects if an object is (known) to be a complex number or tensor.

methods.name: split_complex_arg
methods.description: Splits a complex argument into real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: split_complex_tensor
methods.description: Splits a ComplexTensor into its real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: complex_to_real_dtype
methods.description: Converts a complex dtype to its corresponding real dtype.

methods.name: register_error
methods.description: Registers an error-raising implementation for an op.

methods.name: register_binary_nonlinear
methods.description: Registers a binary nonlinear operation (e.g., multiplication) for complex tensors.

methods.name: register_simple
methods.description: Registers an op that can be applied independently to real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: _as_complex_tensor
methods.description: Converts a Tensor with complex dtype to a ComplexTensor.

methods.name: _as_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a ComplexTensor to a Tensor with complex dtype.
